summary: v2 refinement validated end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (/api/health 200, /api/intake POST happy path + persistence via /api/intake/count delta, 422 on invalid email/empty reflection/>600 chars/missing fields, 200 at boundary 600 chars). Frontend desktop @1920px and mobile @390px: homepage loads (HTTP 200, no console errors), wordmark renders the single string 'Tattvashila' in both nav-wordmark and footer-wordmark with zero inner <span> children (no italic split), all hero testids present (section-threshold, threshold-eyebrow/headline/sub/cta-primary='Read the philosophy'/cta-secondary='Stay in touch'/image), Premise renders with premise-image, Philosophy renders all 4 tenets (awareness/responsibility/discipline/conscious-participation), Ecosystem renders all 4 chambers (tattvapeetha/traksha/vanatattva/shreetattva), Journey renders with journey-image, Intake form submits and is replaced by intake-success, nav-intake-cta visible on desktop (hidden on mobile) and nav-intake-cta-mobile visible on mobile (hidden on desktop), all 4 footer links present (philosophy/ecosystem/journey/reflective-intake), all 3 Unsplash images load (naturalWidth=1400), no horizontal overflow at 390px (scrollWidth==clientWidth==390).
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/.env contains TWO different backend URLs — REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://essence-5... and NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://8623c000... — both currently resolve to backends responding 200 on /api/health, but the Intake form uses NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL while pytest uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. They should point to the same origin to avoid drift; one of them is the real preview URL of this container, the other appears to be a leftover from an earlier session.

QuietImage uses a plain with loading='eager' for all three hero/premise/journey images — fine for an above-the-fold trio on a 7-section page, but if more imagery is added in v3, switch non-critical ones to loading='lazy' and consider Next.js for built-in srcset/AVIF.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True remains permissive (carried from v1); tighten to production origin before launch.
POST /api/intake remains unrate-limited and unauth'd — add IP throttling or hCaptcha before public launch.
Wordmark.tsx is good (single text node, no nested italic span) — confirmed via DOM inspection that nav-wordmark and footer-wordmark contain zero child <span> elements.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app
